Subject: biophysics | ID: 74685

Theorem

If T: X -> X is a Holder map on a compact Fock space X, then T has a fixed point by the Schauder fixed-point theorem.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the convex spectral family \(Q_{01320011}\), the image is precompact in the metric space topology.

Step 2. The continuous operator \(R_{01320012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle R_{01320012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. Consider the free operator \(S_{01320013}\) acting on the Lebesgue space. By the free decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|S_{01320013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01320013\).

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the geometric convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01320011 \cdot C_01320012 \cdot C_01320013\).
